note: Machine-readable qualification matrix for the real autofill, password-manager and screen-reader surfaces. The surface ids and the required/advisory split are authoritative in tests/browser/qualification/surfaces.json (schema kiwicaptcha.autofill-surfaces/1); docs/autofill-qualification-protocol.md refers to the same ids. Every row must be executed on the listed surface with the exact version, and the decoy invariant must hold (legitimate fill never writes a value under the authenticated decoy name). Status values: manual_pending (no real qualification has happened), pass (the surface qualified with an exact version within the record window), fail, blocked. tested_at is the strict ISO-8601 date of the qualification run for a pass row; version is the exact tested surface version, and 'CURRENT' is a placeholder that may only ride a non-pass row. Nothing here is marked pass: no real qualification has happened yet, so the validator refuses this matrix as the release gate stands (fail-closed).
